name: Claude Code (GitHub Enterprise Server)
manual_steps: Prefer the guided setup in Claude's Organization settings > Git providers, which creates the app from a manifest.
If you create the app by hand: enter the app ID, client ID, client secret, webhook secret and private key in Claude, then copy the webhook URL Claude generates into the app's webhook settings.
notes: Claude's docs warn that GitHub applies a manifest only at creation: an app created from an earlier manifest keeps its old permissions and events, so compare it with this entry. Requires a Claude Team or Enterprise plan.
